Frequently Asked Questions

How long does mechanized tank cleaning take?

A typical 1000-liter overhead tank takes 45 to 60 minutes using our mechanized high-pressure pumps and vacuum cleaners.

Do I need to empty the tank before the technician arrives?

No. Our crew brings submersible sludge dewatering pumps to safely pump out residue.

What payment methods are supported?

We support online UPI, credit/debit cards via Razorpay, and cash upon service completion.
